question: **Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:** The parchment bore the symbol of a tau cross.

options.text: The Greek tau marked the margin of the codex.
The mason engraved a tau on the keystone.
The investor tracked the rising tau in currency markets.
The friar carved a wooden tau for pilgrimage.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tau"** in the sentence refers to the Greek letter (τ) or a symbol resembling it. (ताऊ)
 
 
• **Example:** The parchment bore the symbol of a tau cross, which is shaped like the Greek letter.
 
 
• **"Tau"** in the context of Option 3 is a homonym, as it refers to a statistical term representing time or rate in currency markets. (ताऊ, सांख्यिकी में समय या दर)
 
 
• **Example:** The investor carefully monitored the rising tau to predict market trends.
 
 
• Homonyms are words that sound or are spelled the same but have different meanings.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The Greek tau marked the margin of the codex. (ताऊ, ग्रीक अक्षर)
 
 
• **Example:** The scribe used the Greek tau to highlight the important sections of the manuscript.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The mason engraved a tau on the keystone. (ताऊ, प्रतीक)
 
 
• **Example:** The tau symbol was carefully chiseled onto the keystone to signify strength and stability.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The friar carved a wooden tau for pilgrimage. (ताऊ, धार्मिक प्रतीक)
 
 
• **Example:** The friar carried the wooden tau as a symbol of his devotion during the pilgrimage.
 
 

5c:T9e0,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
